verdict.rationale: LlamaParse documents an official MCP server at https://mcp.llamaindex.ai/mcp that exposes Parse, Classify, Extract, Split, and Index as callable tools for any MCP client, and a runtime probe confirms a related docs MCP endpoint completes a full initialize handshake, corroborating the capability is live rather than just claimed. Missing for 10: independent third-party (non-vendor) confirmation of a successful end-to-end agent tool call against the parsing MCP endpoint itself.
